blurb: Guests can rent equipment for camping, hiking, climbing, snow sports, watercraft, home maintenance, and more. The center offers classes on hiking, skiing, biking, camping, rock climbing, kayaking, rafting, and other outdoor skills. Facilities include a disc golf course, lakes, pavilions, and lodging options like Cedar Lodge and Fam Camp.
